title: Sexual Arousal
summary: Arousal is the body's and mind's sexual excitement. Blood flow to the genitals increases, causing erection or swelling and lubrication, along with faster breathing and heart rate.
key_points: Arousal involves the mind as much as the body.
Physical signs (like lubrication or erection) don't always match wanting sex — and never equal consent.
Stress, anxiety or feeling unsafe can block arousal.
answer_guidance: Explain simply. If the user mixes up arousal and consent, make clear that a body reacting is not a yes.
